name: Jigsaw Toxic Comment Classification / Civil Comments
restrictions: Public domain dataset; verify sub-corpus attribution before inclusion.
description: Multi-label toxicity benchmark covering toxicity, severe_toxicity, obscene, threat, insult, identity_attack.

name: HateXplain Benchmark
restrictions: MIT license; requires attribution in downstream releases.
description: Benchmark for hate speech and offensive content with rationales and target community annotations.

name: Davidson Automated Hate Speech and Offensive Language
restrictions: MIT license; verify social platform data terms compliance.
description: Offensive language vs hate speech separation with crowd-annotated hostility labels.

name: TextDetox / ParaDetox Parallel Toxicity Corpus
restrictions: Apache-2.0; do not inherit sibling repository licenses without inspection.
description: Parallel toxic and neutralized text pairs across English, Russian, and Hindi.

name: Ryerson Audio-Visual Database of Emotional Speech and Song (RAVDESS)
restrictions: Non-commercial research only; commercial deployment strictly prohibited.
description: Acted emotional speech recordings covering calm, happy, sad, angry, fearful, surprise, and disgust expressions.

name: Crowd-sourced Emotional Multimodal Actors Dataset (CREMA-D)
restrictions: Open Database License; share-alike requirements on derived databases.
description: Multi-actor voice recordings annotated for emotional intent and intensity.

name: Synthetic Harassment Scenario Generator A
restrictions: Training only; independent evaluation must use Generator B in Rust (hre-eval).
description: Deterministic multi-seed synthetic conversation histories modeling 14 harassment scenario classes.

name: Held-Out Regional Evaluation Benchmark
restrictions: Held-out evaluation benchmark; strictly prohibited from training split.
description: Fresh manually authored test samples in English, Hindi, Hinglish, Marathi, and Konkani for unbiased evaluation.
